## About this round

SCF #44 Build award (Integration track) for 'Choppaddi Pay': stablecoin (USDC) payments for its food, grocery and local-essentials marketplace. Founder Chijioke 'CJ' Ogbechie died 18 Dec 2025; co-founders Progress Ochuko Eyaadah and Chukwuemeka ('DoctorVee') now lead. Award listed in the SCF #44 round recap published 24 Jul 2026 (round closed for submissions 14 Jun 2026); Stellar Nigeria / Dealroom / Technext publicised the Nigerian winners on 19 Aug 2026. XLM-denominated award, USD value as stated by SCF.
